 This miscellaneous appeal having been heard and reserv  orders, coming on for pronouncement this day, Justice Achal K  Paliwal pronounced the following:
 ORDER

This appeal by the claimant under section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act is arising out of the award dated 18.10.2023 passed by MACT, Mandleshwar (WN) in Claim Case No.14/2021 seeking enhancement of compensation amount awarded by the Tribunal.
2. The date of accident, negligence and the issue of liability are not in dispute and the findings recorded by the Tribunal in this regard are also not in question.

As per the findings of the Tribunal,
for the permanent disability sustained by the appellant/claimant, the Tribunal has awarded a total compensation of Rs.1,07,000/- along with interest.

The breakup of the compensation amount is as under:
 Medical expenses -Rs.5000/-
 Transportation -Rs.2000/-
 Pain & suffering etc. -Rs.1,00,000/
 -------------
 TOTAL Rs.1,07,000/-

2

3. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the Tribunal has committed an error in not awarding just and proper amount of compensation in the case as the amount awarded by the Tribunal is on the lower side.
The compensation awarded under other conventional heads is on the lower side, hence prays for just and proper amount of compensation in the case.

4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the Insurance Company argued in support of the impugned award and contended that the Claims Tribunal has rightly awarded the compensation amount in the case which does not call for any interference by this Court.
5. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record, I find substance in the arguments advanced by the counsel for the appellant.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and arguments advanced by the counsel for the appellant, in the considered opinion of this Court, the compensation awarded by the Tribunal in this case deserves to be enhanced as under:
 Pain & suffering etc. -Rs.1,00,000/-
 Other conventional heads  i.e. medical expenses/ special  diet/attendant etc. -Rs.20,000/-
 -------------------
 TOTAL Rs.1,20,000/-
6. Thus, the just and proper amount of compensation in the instant case is Rs.1,20,000/- as against the award of the Tribunal of Rs.1,07,000/-.
Accordingly, the appellant is entitled to an additional sum of Rs.13,000/- over and above the amount which has been awarded by the Tribunal.
7. In the result, the appeal is partly allowed by enhancing the compensation amount by a sum of Rs.13,000/-.
The enhanced amount shall bear interest at the same rate as awarded by the Tribunal.
The other findings recorded by the Tribunal shall remain intact.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE hk/
